title: HCS MCP client limits
description: Limits a host declares for one MCP client it projects to (HCS-0008 section 6.9, R036). Units are in the member names; HCS defines no default value.

instructionsPrefix.description: Characters of the server instructions the client is known to keep, counted from the start.

toolListBytes.description: Largest tools/list result the client takes, as the UTF-8 bytes of the compact JSON `tools` array (R037).
